notes.title: Crypto Crisis will soon be Free to Play!
notes.notes:
Crypto Crisis was the first game I developed, released and published. It hasn't seen any love for the better part of 3 years and has been slowly fading away.

Creating the Education Edition of this game with Kieran Nolan, Principal Trotter and the rest of the students at Wooranna Park Primary School in Melbourne (Australia) was a great experience! Even though it's a bit rough round the edges and needs some balance work, I want to give it away to people who want to play it.

Please enjoy ːsteamhappyː

Kind Regards,

Jeremy Sik
Former Co-Founder of Armoured Beans

notes.title: Crypto Crisis — EDUCATION EDITION! Article by Kieran Nolan
notes.notes:
[url=https://medium.com/nem-anz/crypto-crisis-education-edition-9bba64b1512d]
Students at Wooranna Park Primary School have been asked to create a narrative for the upcoming education edition of Crypto Crisis!
[/url]

In the past, the students at Wooranna Park Primary School have used the NEM blockchain to vote on the allocation of 21BTC to build a STEaM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts and Maths) Centre. This space has enabled students to learn about all aspects of cryptocurrencies; from building full nodes, to multisig transactions, to exploring the blockchain in VR, to hardware wallets - and storing public/private keys.Up until now, the students have only been able to learn about mining in theory, not in practice. Crypto Crisis — Education Edition is going to change that by giving students the ability to learn about the technology first hand in a fun environment, and a narrative that they have created!

Continue reading at:
[url=https://medium.com/nem-anz/crypto-crisis-education-edition-9bba64b1512d]https://medium.com/nem-anz/crypto-crisis-education-edition-9bba64b1512d[/url]
